description: Select a quote returned by quote_life_eapp for that same application. Requires its private application_token, application-bound quote_id, and explicit user confirmation. Applies the selected rating inputs and quote, retains quote history, and returns the completion link. Rejects stale selections and locked/submitted applications. Give the user the private apply_link and explain that they must open it to continue in Quote & Apply, complete the remaining application steps, and sign where required. This MCP action does not complete or submit the application to a carrier or bind coverage.

application_token.description: Private application_token returned by create_life_eapp; an eApp ID, UUID, or completion URL is not accepted

user_confirmed.description: The user explicitly requested these application changes

name: update_life_eapp_quote
